habitat: A varied site: gypseous plain, gypseous hill-slopes, planed limestone and stone-mantles and a water-course incised 3m into solid anhydrite. Limestone stone-mantles:
occurrenceRemarks: 'Acacia tortilis, Commiphora, Euphorbia cunneata/spinescens, Disperma eremophilum, Zygophyllum hildebrandtii, Cadaba heterotricha with H7W 3156. In deep water-course Sterculia sp, Capparis cartilaginea, Ficus, Moringa More ([illegible] 3157) and tree to 8m (H&W 3158). Slopes of gypsum hills: Acacia, Jatropha, illegible hildebrandtii and leafless [illegible] (H7W 3159)
name: Gossypium vollesenii Fryxell
